title: Count the capital letters
summary: isupper: the same loop as counting letters, with a different question for each character.
hints: Same loop as `count-letters`: `for (i = 0; line[i] != '\0'; i++)` and `if (isupper(line[i]))`.
`isupper` is true only for `A`-`Z`: lower case letters, digits and symbols give 0.
